tools.name: search_robots
tools.description: Search the robot directory at geppettorobotdirectory.com for 830+ robots by category, brand, price range, or use case. Returns robot name, slug, category, brand, price range, and key specs.

tools.name: get_robot
tools.description: Get full specs and details for a specific robot by its slug. Returns all specifications, price, brand, description, features, and direct URL.

tools.name: compare_robots
tools.description: Compare two robots side by side on specs, price, and capabilities. Returns a comparison URL and key differences.

tools.name: get_job_automation_risk
tools.description: Get the Geppetto Robot Impact Score (0-100) for any profession. Composite of task-automation research (35%, the Oxford Frey and Osborne score), IFR robot deployment (30%), an academic-consensus score (20%, the average of the Oxford score and the OECD risk band), and robot density (15%). The O*NET-SO

tools.name: get_category
tools.description: Get all robots in a specific category with specs and prices. Returns the full list of active robots in that category from the robot directory at geppettorobotdirectory.com.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search the robot directory at geppettorobotdirectory.com for 1,000+ robot training datasets by platform, modality, license, or commercial-use. Returns name, slug, platforms, sensor modalities, episode count, hours, license, access type, and URL.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Get the full record for a specific robot training dataset by slug: specs, license, access type, collection method, citation, and source links.

tools.name: get_component_category
tools.description: Get a robot hardware component category (a 'part' type) by slug, with its supply-chain analysis and full supplier list: bottleneck risk, China concentration, supplier counts, and each supplier.

tools.name: search_suppliers
tools.description: Search the robot directory at geppettorobotdirectory.com for 140+ robot hardware component suppliers by component category, country, or keyword. Returns name, slug, component category, country, public-listing/stock code, and bottleneck risk.

tools.name: get_supplier
tools.description: Get the full record for a specific robot hardware supplier by slug: components supplied, OEM relationships, country, public-listing and stock code, bottleneck risk, and sources.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
